workstream.title: R06 · Student World / Jose / study engine recovery

human_intent: Recover the Student World / Jose / shared study-engine lineage, materially continue it as one coherent student path, preserve representative subject/class identities, and persist enough evidence and continuation state that a fresh AI can integrate or continue without old chats or human prompt transport.
already_decided: Version numbers are never compared across unrelated lineages; exact source identity and lineage decide authority.
Student World, subject pages, class pages, atlas pages, homework pages and the shared study engine remain distinct product identities.
The José subject page remains explicitly labeled reconstruction evidence; it must not be silently promoted to authentic historical bytes.
shared/study/current.json remains the explicit shared Study UI contract pointer: v1 / 1.0.0 unless its owner performs a compatible fix or explicit major migration.
Student-specific content/state must not fork or own shared Study CSS/JS.
Selection is not activation; scroll/drag is not click; mouse/touch/keyboard activation semantics must stay coherent.
Subject state uses one semantic slot; typography roles stay semantic; printed math must not degrade into code-like math.
student-world/runtime/v2 is a TESTED_CANDIDATE in Current, not a Human Accepted/Served promotion.
Representative pages are preserved by reference/linkage, not flattened into a generic replacement page.
high_value_targets: Give a fresh worker one coherent World -> Subject -> Study/Class -> Practice/Homework path without inventing a second product authority.
Extract and name the strongest reusable study primitives so future student pages compose them rather than fork them.
Keep exact evidence labels for live library pages, reconstructions, shared contracts and tested candidates.
Make integration review cheap: one recovery digest, one durable path page, one LAST_RETURN and one PR.

FAST.use_when: The requested change is explicit, local, reversible and does not require material architectural decisions.
forbidden_overhead: release receipts for ordinary LAB iteration

DEEP.use_when: The task is materially ambiguous, multi-file, design-heavy or benefits from deciding the space before editing.
sequence: CONTEXT FIRST: write the material understanding that can change execution
COMPLETE MAP: name all meaningful parts before diving into part one
DEVELOP: resolve important decisions under those headings
EXECUTE: implement as much of the map as tool/context boundaries allow
CRITIQUE: inspect the actual result for contradictions and lost value
REPAIR: fix worker-soluble failures in the same work cycle
DEEP.rule: Context/map/specification are decision compression, not deliverables to endlessly regenerate.

EXHAUSTIVE.use_when: The human explicitly requests exhaustive coverage/a numbered map, or the work is structural enough that omission risk dominates.
sequence: print the complete requested title map once
develop it at the requested depth
execute continuously from the frozen frontier
rules: A requested count such as 100 is a coverage matrix, not permission for filler.
After PLAN:FROZEN, later turns must not regenerate the same plan.
N/A or DEFER with a reason is better than fake work.
A response-length boundary is not a project boundary; persist the frontier and continue.

CONTINUE.use_when: The conversation already has a materially sufficient context/map/specification or the human sends dot to continue.
